selection_rationale.scout_lane: No admission-ready committed source remained after the prior SEC contract-relation rejection and this run's outcome-blind source audit; failed inputs were not retried and no experiment ID was reserved.
selection_rationale.chosen_unit: The next safe promotion-construction slice was a typed external source-population coverage contract and immutable universe-manifest reconciliation guard.
selection_rationale.scope_boundary: Promotion-only contract work; no CandidatePool, Hypothesis, promotion request, scout admission, experiment registry, persistence, runtime, broker, order, position, allocation, or permission path.

implementation.coverage_contract: Freezes universe/scope/manifest identities, exact coverage SourceContract/EvidenceRecord identities, complete stable source-row id/hash population, mapped/unmapped/excluded dispositions, effective mapping evidence, chronology, counts, and research-only default-off ceilings.
implementation.evidence_binding: Coverage EvidenceRecord decision_content must match enumeration_complete=true, reported row count, scope identity/hash, and the complete sorted row id/hash surface; mapping and mapping evidence must be known by data_cutoff, recorded by freeze, and cover membership_as_of.
implementation.ledger_binding: The read-only ledger cross-validator composes full source/evidence validation and requires the deduplicated mapped (security_id, listing_id, mapping_sha256) set to equal every non-retired membership in the exact target manifest; evidence-backed known-empty requires empty active membership.

initial_findings: P1: manifest reconciliation could be called without source/evidence input validation
P1: mapping EvidenceRecord known_at was not explicitly constrained to data_cutoff
fixes: Made the ledger cross-validator require and internally compose the exact coverage/mapping input validators, and bound input_binding_sha256 into its output hash.
Required mapping evidence known_at <= data_cutoff and added an adversarial late-evidence regression case.
review.final_verdict: Independent re-review found both P1 findings closed and no remaining P0/P1.
